entries.heading: DEFINITION OF COMMANDANT
ancestors: DIVISION G—ELIJAH E. CUMMINGS COAST GUARD AUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2020
entries.text:
SEC. 8002. DEFINITION OF COMMANDANT.

    In this division, the term ``Commandant'' means the Commandant of 
the Coast Guard.
